presets.name: Ollama (on your computer)
presets.description: Models running in Ollama on your own machine. Free and private.
presets.baseUrlHint: On the emulator use http://10.0.2.2:11434/v1. On a phone, use your computer's LAN or Tailscale address, and start Ollama with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0.
presets.dataUseNote: Prompts stay on your own machine.
presets.limitsNote: Ollama's default context window is 4,096 tokens, and the app can't change it per request. Long prompts (Finalise includes the whole Suno guide, about 6,000 tokens) are silently cut off unless you raise it: Ollama app → Settings → Context length, or set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=16384 and restart Ollama.

presets.name: LM Studio (on your computer)
presets.description: Models served by LM Studio's local server. Free and private.
presets.baseUrlHint: Start the server in LM Studio (Developer tab). On the emulator use http://10.0.2.2:1234/v1. On a phone, enable 'Serve on local network' and use your computer's address.
presets.dataUseNote: Prompts stay on your own machine.

presets.name: OpenRouter
presets.description: One key for hundreds of models, including free ':free' variants. Only free models are used in free-only mode.
presets.dataUseNote: Free models are hosted by third-party providers, some of which log prompts or use them for training. Check each model's provider on openrouter.ai.
presets.limitsNote: Free models: 20 requests/minute, 50/day (1,000/day once you have bought at least $10 of credit). Failed requests count towards the daily cap.

presets.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
presets.description: Gemini models with a free API tier. No card needed.
presets.dataUseNote: On the free tier, Google may use your prompts and responses to improve its products, and human reviewers may read them.
presets.limitsNote: Free-tier limits vary by model and project and change often. Check AI Studio's rate-limit page for your actual values. Daily limits reset at midnight Pacific time.

presets.name: Groq
presets.description: Very fast open-weight models (e.g. gpt-oss, Qwen) with a free developer tier.
presets.dataUseNote: Check Groq's current data-use policy before sending anything private.
presets.limitsNote: Per-model limits, typically 30 requests/minute and 1,000/day for chat models. Groq reports remaining requests in response headers.

presets.name: Mistral
presets.description: Mistral's models. The free plan needs a phone-verified account.
presets.dataUseNote: On the free plan, Mistral may use your prompts to train its models unless you opt out in the admin console.
presets.limitsNote: Limits are set per workspace. Check the admin console for your values.

presets.name: GitHub Models
presets.description: Models from several vendors, free with a GitHub account. Use a personal access token with the models:read permission.
presets.dataUseNote: Check GitHub's current data-use policy for GitHub Models before sending anything private.
presets.limitsNote: Free limits depend on the model's tier and your Copilot plan: low-tier models about 15 requests/minute and 150/day, high-tier about 10/minute and 50/day. The defaults here assume high-tier.

presets.name: Cerebras
presets.description: Very fast inference for open-weight models. Paid: new accounts get a short trial credit.
presets.dataUseNote: Check Cerebras' current data-use policy for your plan.
presets.limitsNote: No free tier: API access needs a verified payment method. New accounts get $5 of trial credit that expires after 30 days, limited to 5 requests a minute and 1M tokens a day per model. Raise the per-minute limit if you're on a paid plan.

presets.name: Ollama Cloud
presets.description: Large models hosted by Ollama, using an ollama.com API key.
presets.dataUseNote: Check Ollama's current data-use policy for cloud models.
presets.limitsNote: Unverified: Ollama's free plan includes a small starter allowance each month on a few starter models (not named), one request at a time; other usage is paid with credits. Turn on 'free tier key' only if you're sure the models you pick are covered.

presets.name: Claude API (Anthropic)
presets.description: Claude models directly, with an Anthropic API key. Paid per token.
presets.dataUseNote: Anthropic's commercial terms say API prompts and replies aren't used to train its models by default. Check its current policy.
presets.limitsNote: Uses Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Limits depend on your account tier and are reported in response headers. Add the models' prices to the price table for cost estimates.

presets.name: OpenAI API (ChatGPT models)
presets.description: GPT models directly, with an OpenAI API key. Paid per token; separate from a ChatGPT subscription.
presets.dataUseNote: OpenAI says data sent to its API isn't used to train models unless you opt in. Check its current policy.
presets.limitsNote: Limits depend on your usage tier and are reported in response headers. The model list includes image, audio and embedding models: pick a chat model. Add prices to the price table for cost estimates.

presets.name: xAI API (Grok)
presets.description: Grok models directly, with an xAI API key. Paid per token; separate from a Grok or X subscription.
presets.dataUseNote: Check xAI's current data-use policy for API requests before sending anything private.
presets.limitsNote: Limits depend on your account. Add the models' prices to the price table for cost estimates.

presets.name: DeepSeek API
presets.description: DeepSeek models directly, with a DeepSeek API key. Paid per token, and inexpensive.
presets.dataUseNote: DeepSeek stores API data on servers in China. Check its current privacy policy before sending anything private.
presets.limitsNote: Add the models' prices to the price table for cost estimates.

presets.name: Claude app (relay)
presets.description: Claude's free plan, through the Claude app. No API needed: the app hands you a ready-made prompt, you paste it into Claude and share the reply back.
presets.dataUseNote: Prompts go through your own Claude account and follow that app's privacy settings.

presets.name: ChatGPT app (relay)
presets.description: ChatGPT's free plan, through the ChatGPT app. No API needed: the app hands you a ready-made prompt, you paste it into ChatGPT and share the reply back.
presets.dataUseNote: Prompts go through your own ChatGPT account and follow that app's privacy settings.

presets.name: Gemini app (relay)
presets.description: The Gemini app, for when you'd rather use it than an API key. No API needed: the app hands you a ready-made prompt, you paste it into Gemini and share the reply back.
presets.dataUseNote: Prompts go through your own Gemini account and follow that app's privacy settings.

presets.name: Grok app (relay)
presets.description: Grok's free plan, through the Grok app. No API needed: the app hands you a ready-made prompt, you paste it into Grok and share the reply back.
presets.dataUseNote: Prompts go through your own Grok account and follow that app's privacy settings.

presets.name: DeepSeek app (relay)
presets.description: DeepSeek's free chat, through the DeepSeek app. No API needed: the app hands you a ready-made prompt, you paste it into DeepSeek and share the reply back.
presets.dataUseNote: Prompts go through your own DeepSeek account and follow that app's privacy settings.

presets.name: Other chat app (relay)
presets.description: Any chat app: enter its package name. You paste prompts and share replies back.
presets.dataUseNote: Depends on the app. Check its privacy settings before sending anything private.

presets.name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible)
presets.description: Any server that implements /chat/completions and /models.
presets.dataUseNote: Depends on the provider. Check its terms before sending anything private.
